dedupe_keys.name: conae space object re entry monitoring reports argentina

description: CONAE, the Argentine national space agency, has run an operational system for monitoring the re-entry of space objects since the end of 2011, working 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The page says the system gives information to the national authorities responsible for managing the risk from re-entering space objects and also produces information for the public, and it links the reports the system generates. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (argentina.gob.ar site-wide statement: contents licensed under CC BY 4.0). Access is free of charge. Caveats: the page describes the service briefly and does not say how often reports are issued, which objects are covered or what archive is kept, so users should check the reports themselves. Coverage is Argentina for the risk assessment, for objects re-entering from orbit. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response planning for falling space debris over infrastructure and settlements; related records are the EU SST services and the CONAE geoportal.
